response.sql: WITH analyzed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tr.transreg, td.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS td ON td.tradereg = tr.trdref WHERE td.tradekind IS NOT NULL), type_counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_count FROM analyzed_trades GROUP BY tradekind), benchmark AS (SELECT SUM(trade_count) AS total_count, AVG(trade_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(tc.trade_count) AS combined_count, AVG(1.0 * tc.trade_count / b.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(tc.trade_count - b.average_count) AS average_above_count FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE tc.trade_count > b.average_count

assumptions.assumption: Each trade record is counted once even if it has multiple advanced behaviour records. Traders with no recorded type are excluded from the type counts and total.
